body:
the snake never left — she just taught it to mean the opposite 🐍

i think about this one constantly. 2017: she wipes every post and drops three silent clips of a snake slithering through static. the insult people had been throwing at her, picked up and worn like armor for the whole reputation era.

then 2019. the 'ME!' video opens and there's that same serpent, pink now, and it just... bursts into a cloud of butterflies. the era shed in real time, right there in the first frame.

one symbol, two years apart, carrying two completely opposite meanings. that's the whole game — nothing she shows us is an accident.

we mapped every snake and every payoff across the eras in the easter-eggs lens. tag the friend you were texting the night those snake videos dropped 🫢

follow the trail: https://www.longlivets.com/?lens=easter-eggs&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=easter-eggs
